api_safety_conditions.condition: An initialize_lineage=True boolean proves write intent, not that an arbitrary output belongs to an unpublished generation. validate has no authoritative publication/config input. State the narrow contract as default read-only plus caller-guaranteed fresh/unpublished initialization, or add a real publication check before claiming direct API rejection of every published generation. Bootstrap's fresh directories supply that caller guarantee. Do not auto-initialize a published generation whose two files are missing.

Default success and failure must perform no intentional writes/deletes to either lineage artifact. Always independently derive expected records/state; compare existing canonical payload bytes rather than treating stored status=pass as authority. Missing, partial, malformed, mismatched and symlink outputs must fail without healing.

Initialization must refuse any preexisting destination, including dangling symlink and non-regular path. Path.exists alone is insufficient. Race-safe exclusive publication is required; an exists precheck followed by os.replace still overwrites an entrant. On failure, remove only artifacts demonstrably created by this invocation and never delete preexisting or concurrently replaced destinations. Test second-file publication failure, conflicting initialization, and link/FIFO handling with bounded synthetic fixtures.

Publishing two filenames is not automatically pair-atomic. A crash/kill can leave a partial initial pair. Treat partial state as refusal, not a certificate or automatic retry/overwrite. Distinguish controlled exception cleanup from uncatchable termination and external concurrent mutation guarantees.

Retain F01's explicit legacy/versioned input rules and detached checked document_version_graph result. Index callers must continue to reject missing or forged authority rather than importing a binding from producer state or requesting initialization. Preserve existing legacy/versioned E2E and migration semantics.

Use a keyword-only opt-in parameter after existing version_graph positional parameter. Successful initial fixture calls and initial intentional-failure calls need different review from revalidation. No blanket rewrite of every validator call. Generated timestamps already derive from checked inputs; do not introduce current-time fields that make read-only comparison unstable.
